verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to work with the Stripe API and search Stripe's knowledge base, and a probe confirms it at docs.stripe.com/mcp. It is a platform-wide Stripe server, though, and the evidence does not show which Financial Connections operations it exposes. The agent use cases shown for Financial Connections point to the Link CLI, not MCP. Missing for 10: evidence of Financial Connections-specific MCP tools (accounts, balances, transactions, ownership), setup and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
